This suggests a potential regulatory relationship between Viscidulin Iii and the downstream target Dehydrogenase/reductase SDR family member 9. The evidence implies that Claulansine D, acting on the cAMP-dependent protein kinase, may influence the activity of SDR family member 9, though the direct interaction between Viscidulin Iii and SDR family member 9 remains unestablished. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Viscidulin Iii in modulating the activity of SDR family member 9 through a cAMP-dependent mechanism, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
